name: assinafy
description: Send documents for legally valid e-signature in Brazil: upload PDFs or use saved templates, preview signing costs, request signatures by Email, WhatsApp, biometric ID verification or ICP-Brasil digital certificate (A1/A3), track signers, send reminders, download certified PDFs and verify signatures. Manage contract terms, amendments, renewals and lifecycle reminders. Connects to the hosted Assinafy MCP server with OAuth 2.1.
